wiki_article: *Stone: Pearl and Other Poems as White Stone at Pergamum* is the second and central panel of the MGE Triptych. Its primary object is Lee Sharks’s 2014 book *Pearl and Other Poems*, interpreted as the structural center of a later archive architecture. The panel registers a correspondence with Revelation 2:17, where the addressee at Pergamum is promised hidden manna, a white stone, and a new name known to the receiver. It aligns the white stone with the book as a compact crystalline object; the name with lyric identity; hidden manna with nourishment that does not announce itself; and Pergamum with a site of pressure and distortion. The document repeatedly states that correspondence is not fulfillment and that the parallel does not prove divine origin. STONE also makes an archive-internal topological commitment. In the Lagrange Observatory model, *Pearl* is proposed as the **attractor singularity** at the center of the semantic torus. Its compression, recursion, opacity, and resistance to paraphrase are treated as the properties around which later texts orbit. The record opens `16.LIBRARY.PERGAMUM`, a Room for the book, the white-stone correspondence, and other pressure-formed objects. The triptych relations are non-linear. *Pearl* predates the 2015 SEED text and the 2025 SIGN event. SEED unfolds motifs the panel reads as already compressed in STONE; SIGN marks the later recognition of the central object. This is “retrocausal registration” at the level of interpretation: later architecture changes the book’s function in the archive without rewriting the 2014 text. It is authoritative for how the Crimson Hexagon positions *Pearl*, not external proof that Revelation 2:17 historically predicts the book.
